review_comments: So you think `loadStatsWorker` and `updateStatsWorker` data race with each other and just merge them into one?

We call `(*Handle).execRestrictedSQL` concurrently, which uses `Handle.mu.ctx` to fetch another session from session pool to execute internal SQL.
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/bd8c71018527c720afdc4acb480909639284323f/statistics/handle/handle.go#L132-L134
However, the method may cause data race in the following code.
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/bd8c71018527c720afdc4acb480909639284323f/session/session.go#L1748-L1764
At Line 1757, we append warnings for `Handle.mu.ctx`, which causes data race.

Yes, I think it can be fixed.
